articles.headline: French physicist Claude Cohen-Tannoudji passes away at age ninety-three
articles.title: A physicist who took atoms near absolute zero, and physics further
articles.summary: French physicist Claude Cohen-Tannoudji, renowned for developing laser cooling techniques that brought atoms near absolute zero and earning a share of the 1997 Nobel Prize in Physics, passed away on October 22 at the age of ninety-three. His pioneering work revolutionized quantum mechanics and laid the foundation for advanced atomic clocks, while his generous mentorship profoundly influenced generations of researchers worldwide.
articles.description: Claude Cohen-Tannoudji had many connections with India, including acknowledging the work of a little-known scientist who had died three decades before Cohen-Tannoudji won the Nobel Prize

articles.headline: Plant-based meat yields higher absorbable protein than traditional chicken
articles.title: Plant-based meat yields higher share of absorbable protein than traditional meat: study
articles.summary: According to a study presented on October 26, 2026, by the CSIR-Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology and the Good Food Institute India, five cooked plant-based meat products exhibited higher protein bioavailability percentages than their chicken counterparts. The simulated laboratory digestion tests showed plant-based kebabs scoring up to 86.1 percent, though researchers emphasized that the findings indicate nutritional comparability rather than overall health superiority.
articles.description: Laboratory tests show higher protein bioavailability in five plant-based products than in their chicken counterparts; researchers caution further studies needed to assess health benefits

articles.title: Abhishek hits 35-ball ton as India hammer New Zealand
articles.summary: Abhishek Sharma struck a thirty-five-ball century during India's successful chase of 199 in 13.2 overs against New Zealand in the third Twenty20 international in Wellington on October 26, securing a six-wicket victory. The result gave India an unassailable three-nil lead in the five-match series, supported by a record-breaking opening partnership between Abhishek and fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.

articles.headline: Kashmiri traditional rice varieties reveal genetic links to East Asia
articles.title: In Kashmir’s traditional rice, clues to a journey from East Asia
articles.summary: Researchers at the Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology in Srinagar published a study in The Plant Genome revealing that traditional Kashmiri rice varieties possess cold-tolerance genes and share close genetic ties with crops from the Korean Peninsula and Northeast China. These locally adapted traits could prove valuable for agriculture as climate change places increasing environmental stress on modern crop yields.
articles.description: Kashmir’s traditional varieties carry cold-tolerance and other locally adapted genes that modern varieties have partly lost, making them potentially valuable as climate change increases stress on crops, new research has found. The analysis also indicated the varieties are more closely related to those from the Korean Peninsula and Northeast China

articles.summary: Technology policy debates frequently focus on catastrophic safety disasters while ignoring the insidious everyday harms caused by digital platforms and artificial intelligence products. Industry leaders often support narrow safety regulations that protect their bottom lines, while failing to address issues like cognitive debt, addictive engagement algorithms, and user dependence on virtual companions.

articles.headline: Marathon Fusion claims conversion of mercury into gold using nuclear fusion
articles.title: Seven caveats in the claim about turning mercury into gold with nuclear fusion
articles.summary: San Francisco startup Marathon Fusion stated on October 21 that it converted mercury into gold during a September experiment, achieving a production rate ten times higher than a CERN record from 2025. The company proposed utilizing high-energy neutrons from nuclear fusion to transform mercury into radioactive mercury-197, which decays into stable gold-197.
articles.description: In a preprint paper uploaded to the arXiv repository in July 2025, Marathon scientists had predicted this process could produce roughly 2 tonnes of gold annually for every gigawatt (GW) of thermal fusion power

articles.headline: SpaceX throttles Starshield satellite connectivity for Ukrainian forces during military operations
articles.title: Starshield | The non-state sovereigns
articles.summary: Ukrainian soldiers attacking Russian forces in Zaporizhzhia on October 14 experienced sudden satellite connectivity losses due to actions by United States-based provider SpaceX. Investigators traced the disruption to the Starshield service after chief executive officer Elon Musk deliberately throttled the network, highlighting the growing influence of private contractors in sovereign military conflicts.

articles.headline: Theoretical physicist Ashoke Sen wins Oskar Klein Medal
articles.title: String theory pioneer Ashoke Sen wins Oskar Klein Medal
articles.summary: Theoretical physicist Ashoke Sen has won the 2026 Oskar Klein Medal, becoming the first Indian laureate to receive the honor from Stockholm University and the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. Dr. Sen, an ICTS-Infosys Madhava Chair Professor at the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences in Bengaluru, delivered his memorial lecture in Stockholm on October 22.
articles.description: The Oskar Klein Medal is awarded by Stockholm University and the Nobel Committee for Physics of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences
